title: BAW service flow returns null for employee data when calling internal People API
description: The HR Onboarding BAW process has a service flow that calls our internal People API to fetch the new employee's manager information. Since last Tuesday the service flow is returning null for the manager field even though the API endpoint returns correct data when tested directly.

worklogs.description: Tested the People API directly - returns correct manager data. Tested the BAW HTTP connector call - returns the same correct JSON. The issue is in the variable mapping after the HTTP call.
Reviewed the service flow output mapping. The JSON path in the variable mapping uses $.manager.displayName but the API response changed its structure - it is now $.managerInfo.displayName.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I have traced the issue. The BAW service flow is correctly calling the People API and receiving the right data, but the JSON path used to extract the manager's name from the response has become incorrect. The API changed its response structure last week - the manager information moved from $.manager.displayName to $.managerInfo.displayName. The BAW service flow still has the old path. I need to update the path in the variable mapping and redeploy the snapshot. This is a 30-minute fix....

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Please proceed now - we have new starters tomorrow who need their manager correctly set up in the onboarding workflow.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Working on it now. While I update the mapping, could you ask the People API team to let us know in advance whenever they change their response structure? A change like this with no notice is what causes these kinds of issues.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Also need to check if there are other fields in the service flow that map from the People API - might be more broken paths if the API refactored its structure. Doing a full audit of all JSON paths in this service flow before deploying.
